fluff.overview:
The Fire Scorpion is a sixty-five-ton quadrupedal BattleMech designed by Clan Goliath Scorpion to serve as their totem 'Mech. Introduced in 2852 during the Golden Century, the design reflects the Clan's unique identity, with its four-legged frame deliberately crafted to resemble its namesake arachnid. The claw-like armored guards flanking the cockpit and a raised tail structure give the Fire Scorpion an unmistakable silhouette on the battlefield.

Conceived with a philosophy of rugged, cost-effective production, the Fire Scorpion was intended for quantity deployment rather than individual excellence. Manufactured at the Roche QuadPlex Alpha facility on Roche, the design has seen continuous production for centuries, serving primarily in Clan Goliath Scorpion's second-line garrison forces. Despite the general MechWarrior prejudice against quadrupedal designs and their rough ride, the Fire Scorpion earned a dependable reputation as a garrison and urban combat platform.
fluff.capabilities:
The Fire Scorpion compensates for the inherent space limitations of a quadrupedal chassis by concentrating its firepower into two potent main weapons: a Type KOV LB 10-X Autocannon and an Irrlicht Gamma Series Ultra Autocannon/10. This dual-autocannon arrangement provides a versatile combination of cluster and rapid-fire capability, allowing MechWarriors to adapt their engagement approach to different targets. Each weapon is supplied with three tons of ammunition, ensuring sustained firepower during extended engagements or Trials.

Where the Fire Scorpion truly excels is in durability. Fourteen tons of Forging SA722 armor with CASE protection give the design exceptional survivability for its weight class, allowing it to absorb punishment that would cripple lighter garrison 'Mechs. The Coriolis Class VI Endo Steel QuadFrame provides inherent stability that makes the 'Mech an excellent firing platform, particularly in the confined streets and corridors of urban environments.

These advantages come at a cost. A standard 260-rated fusion engine limits the Fire Scorpion to just sixty-five kilometers per hour, and the complete absence of jump jets restricts its maneuverability. Ten single heat sinks keep production costs low but offer minimal thermal overhead. The design's reliance on ammunition-fed weapons creates a potential vulnerability, though generous magazine capacity mitigates this concern in most engagements. Anti-Personnel Pods mounted in each leg provide a final layer of defense against unarmored infantry attempting to swarm the low-slung chassis.
fluff.history:
The Fire Scorpion's origins trace to the early Golden Century, when Clan Goliath Scorpion's scientist caste undertook the creation of a totem 'Mech to embody their Clan's identity. An initial design was produced as early as 2834, but the refined production model entered service in 2852, manufactured at the Roche QuadPlex Alpha facility on the Goliath Scorpion world of Roche. From its inception, the design prioritized rugged simplicity and ease of production over cutting-edge performance, reflecting a deliberate philosophy of equipping garrison forces in quantity.

The Fire Scorpion first demonstrated its combat worth during the absorption of Clan Widowmaker, when fighting on Roche itself gave the design a baptism of fire in the urban environments for which it was built. The quadruped proved tenacious in city fighting, its low profile and heavy armor allowing it to anchor defensive positions against Widowmaker forces. This early reputation defined the Fire Scorpion's role for centuries to come.

Throughout the Political Century and beyond, the Fire Scorpion served as a mainstay of Clan Goliath Scorpion's second-line garrison Clusters. While front-line units preferred more mobile OmniMech designs, garrison commands valued the Fire Scorpion's reliability, low maintenance requirements, and effectiveness in urban defense scenarios. The Clan's preference for deploying the 'Mech alongside Elemental infantry became standard tactical doctrine, with combined-arms Stars using the Fire Scorpion as a mobile strongpoint to support battle armor operations.

The Fire Scorpion remained almost exclusively within Goliath Scorpion ranks until the upheavals of the Jihad era. The arrival of Clan Hell's Horses in the Inner Sphere brought captured Fire Scorpions into contact with new foes, and the modified third variant was observed in combat against Clan Jade Falcon forces on Lackhove. Following the Wars of Reaving and Clan Goliath Scorpion's transformation into the Scorpion Empire, the Roche production facility passed to Clan Cloud Cobra control during the early Republic era, though the facility's long-term operational status under its new owners remains uncertain.

The Fire Scorpion's legacy as one of the few dedicated quadrupedal totem 'Mechs in Clan history ensures its continued significance as both a military asset and cultural symbol, even as production circumstances have shifted far from the Goliath Scorpion origins that inspired the design.
fluff.deployment: The base Fire Scorpion represents the original 2852 production design, built to fill a garrison and urban defense role within Clan Goliath Scorpion's second-line forces. Its dual autocannon armament provides flexible engagement options against both 'Mechs and vehicles, while the Anti-Personnel Pods in each leg deter infantry from exploiting the quadruped's low cockpit position. Goliath Scorpion doctrine commonly pairs the Fire Scorpion with Elemental Points, using the 'Mech's heavy armor and sustained firepower to anchor defensive positions while battle armor troopers clear buildings and engage targets at close range.
